title: sanguisorba minor subsp. lasiocarpa
intro: Sanguisorba minor subsp. lasiocarpa, commonly known as the 'tall burnet', is a perennial herb in the rose family (Rosaceae) native to Europe and Western Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine to support digestive health and to treat conditions such as diarrhea and ulcers, due to its anti-inflammatory and astringent properties. The health benefits of Sanguisorba minor subsp. lasiocarpa are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including its ability to soothe and protect the mucous membranes, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include tannins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
